summary: Phase 3 Cycle 2 — Frontend-only e2e test of Partner Portal Purchase Orders at /partner-portal/purchase-orders. Logged in as Partner Alpha owner, exercised the full lifecycle: list+7 buckets, create-PO wizard (step 1 supplier/warehouse validation + step 2 catalogue type-ahead, add line, qty PATCH, subtotal recompute, submit), detail page (status chip, stat cards, lines table, audit trail), Cancel modal (empty-reason toast + confirmed cancellation with red banner), and Receive drawer (empty-qty toast, partial receive → partially_received, full receive → received + receipts list). Used the DEMO Delta supplier login via curl to acknowledge+ship the submitted PO between the create and receive UI steps, per the review request. All 11 spec bullets passed. No blocking issues.

issues: After full receipt, screenshot shows the Product cell rendering only the supplier_sku line (e.g. 'DELTA-prd_0241') and the product_name text collapsed vertically — the DOM does contain both strings back-to-back ('Œufs FermiersDELTA-prd_0241') but visually the name row appears empty on some line heights. Consider explicit line-height / block separation between product_name and supplier_sku spans in <td> at PurchaseOrdersPage.jsx line 489.

React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — noise from the injected instrumentation spans (x-* attributes) inside <option> tags. Not user-visible; only affects dev warnings. Safe to ignore.

critical_code_review_comments: PurchaseOrdersPage.jsx line 279 uses `ln.master_product_id.slice(0,12)` as a fallback when supplier_sku is null — will throw if master_product_id is ever null/undefined. Prefer `ln.master_product_id?.slice(0,12) ?? '—'`.

LinePicker useEffect (line 336) silently swallows all errors from /partner/purchase-orders/supplier-catalogue by setting results=[]. A supplier who has 0 catalogue products AND a 500/403 both look identical to the user (no results, no message). Consider distinguishing 'no items' from 'load failed' with a subtle inline hint.

CreatePOModal step 2 has NO progress/back button — once step 2 opens, the only escape is 'Save draft & close' or 'Submit'. Users cannot go back to step 1 to change the supplier (which is actually correct because a draft PO is already created and locking the supplier makes sense, but the UX should say so — 'Supplier is locked once draft is created' hint).
PODetail line 449 `new Date(po.created_at).toLocaleDateString()` will throw if created_at is null (defensive rendering for edge cases where a PO is fetched mid-transition).

Receive drawer disables the input when remaining===0 but still allows the confirm button; sending {po_line_id, qty_received:0} for those lines would be filtered client-side (see line 430 `.filter([_,q]) => q>0`), which is fine, but an entirely-fulfilled PO would still show the 'Receive goods' button if its status stays acknowledged/shipped/partial — currently canReceive is status-based so that's ok, just worth noting.

Search box triggers load() only on Enter — the search value 'q' is NOT included in the useEffect dep array of the list load (line 63 depends on [status, load] and load itself depends on [status,q]). Because load's identity changes when q changes, this actually works but is subtle. Add an explicit 'clear' (×) button next to the search box for better UX.
